name: control-tienda-backend
description: Backend serverless de Control Tienda: reglas, índices y Cloud Functions de Firebase

scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-control-tienda --only firestore,storage "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.mts"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-control-tienda --only firestore "npm --prefix functions run test:integration"
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-control-tienda --export-on-exit ./emulator-data
scripts.emulators:resume: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-control-tienda --import ./emulator-data --export-on-exit ./emulator-data
